senses: fourth son of David and Solomon's rival for the throne
Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
a chief of the people who co-operated with Nehemiah

strongs.def: Adonijah, the name of three Israelites
strongs.from: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah
